name: unplanned_line_curtailment_after_technical_fault
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-86, from Run 45558738725: Warsaw metro line M1, Super Express): a technical fault near a terminal station shortens a running metro line and closes three stations.

candidates.title: Metro line runs only on part of its route after a technical fault
candidates.search_snippet: Metro line runs only on part of its route after a technical fault.
candidates.source_content: Because of a technical fault near the northern terminal station, metro trains on line M1 are running only between two intermediate stations. Three stations at the northern end of the line are closed while technicians repair the fault. The operator advised passengers to use trams and buses and said that full service would resume once the repair is complete.
